findings.explanation: HOL4 introduces FUN_FMAP by new_specification with only: FINITE P ==> FDOM (FUN_FMAP f P) = P /\ (!x. x IN P ==> FUN_FMAP f P ' x = f x). Every saved theorem that fixes its value needs FINITE P (FUN_FMAP_EMPTY, FDOM_FMAP, FRANGE_FMAP, FLOOKUP_FUN_FMAP, FUN_FMAP_INSERT), so the value on an infinite P is left open. The Lean definition returns FEMPTY when P is infinite, so Lean proves, for example, FUN_FMAP f UNIV = FEMPTY over Nat, FDOM (FUN_FMAP f UNIV) = {} and FLOOKUP (FUN_FMAP f UNIV) k = none. HOL4 cannot derive these.
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.Prelude.FMap
open HOL

theorem bdd_list : ∀ l : List Nat, ∃ b : Nat, ∀ x, x ∈ l → x ≤ b := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨0, fun x hx => by simp at hx⟩
  | cons a t ih =>
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨a + b, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
    · omega
    · have := hb x h
      omega

theorem nat_univ_not_finite : ¬ FINITE (UNIV : HOL.Set Nat) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := bdd_list l
  have h2 := hb (b + 1) (hl (b + 1) True.intro)
  omega

example (f : Nat → Nat) : FUN_FMAP f (UNIV : HOL.Set Nat) = (FEMPTY : FMap Nat Nat) := by
  unfold FUN_FMAP
  exact dif_neg nat_univ_not_finite

findings.explanation: HOL4 defines FAPPLY f x = OUTL (fmap_REP f x). Outside the domain this is OUTL (INR one), and the only saved equation for OUTL is OUTL (INL x) = x (sumScript.sml:286). HOL4 therefore proves only x NOTIN FDOM f ==> f ' x = FEMPTY ' x (NOT_FDOM_FAPPLY_FEMPTY) and leaves the value FEMPTY ' x open. Lean returns ARB, which is `default`, so it proves FAPPLY FEMPTY x = ARB, and concretely FAPPLY (FEMPTY : FMap Nat Nat) 0 = 0. HOL4 proves neither.
findings.repair:
opaque FAPPLY_undef {β : Type v} [Inhabited β] : β

def FAPPLY [Inhabited β] (f : FMap α β) (x : α) : β :=
  match f.lookup x with
  | some y => y
  | none => FAPPLY_undef
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.Prelude.FMap
open HOL

example {α β : Type} [Inhabited β] (x : α) : FAPPLY (FEMPTY : FMap α β) x = ARB := rfl

example : FAPPLY (FEMPTY : FMap Nat Nat) 0 = 0 := rfl
